collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HONESTY AND ACCOUNTABILITY (HON-01 to HON-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Small lies, kind fibs, things left unsaid, things forgotten, honest mistakes and the odd careless one. Consequences stay the size of the mistake. Privacy is not lying, truth doesn't automatically fix things, and nobody has to confess, apologize or forgive.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A friend asks where a villager spent the afternoon, somewhere private: say it is private, or make something up.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) disappeared for the whole afternoon. When (subject.he/she) comes back, (friend) asks, just curious, "Where were you?" (subject) doesn't want to say. It isn't anything bad. It's just (subject.his/her) own.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Just... gathering," says (subject). "Gathering what?" "Things." (friend) looks at (subject.his/her) empty hands. (subject) looks at them too. "...I'd rather not say, actually," (subject.he/she) admits. "That's all right," says (friend). "You could have just said that." "I know. I'm out of practice."

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Somewhere I like," says (subject). "I'd rather keep it to myself." (friend) is surprised for a moment, and then nods. "Fair enough." Later (friend) catches (friend.him/her)self wondering about it, and decides to stop. Wherever it was, (subject) came back looking happy. That's enough.
